title: Megatron-Turing NLG 530B
authors: S. Smith, M. Patwary, B. Norick, et al. (20 authors)
before: GPT-3's 175B was the largest dense model publicly described.
problem: Could dense training be pushed further, and what does it take in engineering terms?
breakthrough: 530B dense parameters trained with combined tensor, pipeline and data parallelism.
why: The high-water mark of pure dense scaling, and the clearest evidence that this path was hitting diminishing returns.
next: Chinchilla redirected the field toward data; sparsity took the parameter-count crown.
inherits: Mostly a cautionary datapoint about scaling parameters without scaling data.
